scope: Source re-review of tools/knowme-builder/src/upgrade_journal.rs, engine upgrade integration, rollback CLI and relevant public tests after the two findings in journal-findings.json. Includes confirmation of root staging source corrections. No claim of semantic version migrations, arbitrary external-writer synchronization, power-loss durability, live Windows locking, or completed staged-install smoke.
checked_classes: Stale metadata overwrite: project and generated-lock raw bytes are retained from parsing, supplied as guards even when not rewritten, and checked after the native coordination lock is acquired.
Changed application inputs: planned original application bytes are compared before journal preparation and managed-file writes.
Unrecoverable paths: engine rejects duplicate and reserved managed application paths; apply and load share canonical path, case-insensitive duplicate and reserved journal/lock validation.

Recovery ordering: original bytes and expected result digests are saved before application writes; prepared or rolling-back journals require explicit recovery; rollback checks all entries before restoring files.
Later edits: rollback refuses mismatches with both original and applied content; repeated completed rollback is a no-op.
Process coordination: apply and rollback retain a native file-lock guard throughout their writes; the public test exercises rejection while another process holds the lock.
Compatibility claims: journal implementation explicitly limits itself to one managed-file operation and does not make unsupported historical versions valid.
Staging dependencies: Codex prompts and OpenCode commands are included; dispatch requiring repository lifecycle state is excluded from consumer payload.
Windows staging paths: outside-checkout detection distinguishes path components and accepts absolute relative results for cross-drive destinations.
Evidence limitations: reviewed regression test source; producer-reported execution results are separate and were not independently rerun by this reviewer.
